headline: Ownership Swings Return to Exposed Fronts
war_summary: Since the last edition, Weathered Expanse has swung back: Colonial holdings have fallen from five to three, Wardens risen from one to three, with three bases still unheld. Its nine event rows in two hours make it the liveliest ledger; loss and capture rows may describe a single transfer. Linn Mercy's tally is steady at ten Colonial, none Warden and one unheld, but four event rows have arrived in two hours amid heavy casualty reports. Mooring County's previously unheld base is now Colonial-held, leaving eleven Warden and one Colonial; one event row came in the last two hours. Marban Hollow remains split four Warden, three Colonial and one unheld, quiet over two hours after three rows in six. Nevish Line retains six Warden to two Colonial holdings, with two recent event rows and heavy casualties on both sides. Stlican Shelf has logged five rows in six hours, while many fully held regions report no base events. War 140 remains undecided; 34 victory towns are required.
